command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
grep -E '  (real\.py|real\.sh|scenes\.txt|sizes\.tsv)$' pins.sha256 > pins.sel
[ "$(wc -l < pins.sel)" -eq 4 ] && sha256sum -c pins.sel || { echo "FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
( cd /tmp/items && grep -E '/item\.json$' /tmp/pins.sha256 | sed 's|/item\.json$|.json|' | sha256sum -c - > /tmp/items.check 2>&1 ) || { tail -5 /tmp/items.check; echo "FAIL: a staged STAC item does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "$(grep -c ': OK' /tmp/items.check) STAC items match their pins"
bash real.sh 16 1
